The PR description is designed to go in increasing order of granularity:

1. A PM/customer who doesn't know/care about the engineering details
2. A new engineer trying to familiarize themselves with the codebase
3. An experienced engineer

Each section should not exceed 3-5 sentences to maintain legibility.

If the PR can't be summed up in 3-5 sentences per section, it's likely
  too big of a change to review as one diff.

If you feel this must be one PR and also are unable to condense the
  descriptions to 3-5 sentences, create appendix sections below this template.
  Use the appendix sparingly; **less is more**.

-->
